camera.reason: 50MP Sony OIS main with a 50MP ultrawide and 4K 60fps video on all cameras.

performance.reason: Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 handles most games at high settings.

battery.reason: 7,000mAh with 80W charging lasts well over a day and refills fast.

display.reason: 6.8 inch 1.5K AMOLED at 144Hz with 1,800 nits HBM and 6,500 nits peak.

build.reason: Aluminium frame with Gorilla Glass 7i and IP68 and IP69, but a fiberglass back.

software.reason: realme promises 3 Android upgrades and 4 years of security patches.

value.reason: At 146,000 it pairs the fastest chip here with 12GB and 512GB storage.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye and EEZEPC with official realme warranty.

notes: Only the 12GB 512GB is sold at PriceOye (145,999 in stock on 2026-10-10). EEZEPC lists from 149,990 and Mega.pk 148,999 but out of stock. WhatMobile lists a 3.5mm jack, but other spec listings omit it; recorded as absent, unverified. Update policy is from realme announcement coverage (August 2025).
